data.text:
So there are some 3000 pandals in the city. Covering all of them won't be possible or practical. If you want to do just the big and famous one, even that would be some 200 pandals and on Ashtami/Navami visiting just one of them can eat up 5-6 hours. 

So this needs planning. https://t.co/KYHxFmIMLJ

@Amit4Films @Parthib777 @Exoteric_savy I love pandal hopping but physically I’m not very capable. Also I can’t do the all nighter. But manage to see at least 20-30 pandal every year. Start with South. On Chaturthi. Suruchi, Ekdalia, Hindustan park, Tridhara, Deshopriya  and Ballygaunge cultural. the most famous ones.

@Amit4Films Also be wary of the massive crowd surges post Shashthi,that might compel you to remain queued for hours in a single pandal.Try getting the most famous ones checked before if you can.Sreebhumi, Santosh Mitra Square,Ekdalia Evergreen,Tridhara,Mudiali,Bagbazar,etc.All the best :)
